title: Naturality descent of the representative source-shift square
statement:
theorem derived_source_shift_descent
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt] (s : Option ℕ)
    (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY)
    (c : Comparison l E g s SX SY TX TY)
    (hmodel : ∀ (P I : K l E Y s) (hI : I.IsKInjective) (a : ℤ),
      c.derived.hom.app
          (op (((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P)⟦a⟧),
            (podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I) ≫
        (podReindexingDerivedHom l E X s).map
          (Prod.mkHom
            (((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).commShiftIso a).inv.app
              ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P)).op
            (𝟙 ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj
              ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I)))) ≫
        (CategoryTheory.RingedHomUniverses.sourceShift.{u + 1, u, u, u + 2}
          (ProEt.topology X) (podReindexingRing l E X s)
          ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj
            ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P)) a).inv.app
              ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj
                ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I)) =
      (podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).map
        ((CategoryTheory.RingedHomUniverses.sourceShift.{u + 1, u, u, u + 2}
          (ProEt.topology Y) (podReindexingRing l E Y s)
          ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P) a).inv.app
            ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I)) ≫
        ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).commShiftIso (-a)).hom.app
          ((podReindexingDerivedHom l E Y s).obj
            (op ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P), (podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I)) ≫
        (c.derived.hom.app
          (op ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P), (podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I))⟦-a⟧') :
    ∀ (M N : podReindexingDerived l E Y s) (a : ℤ),
      c.derived.hom.app (op (M⟦a⟧), N) ≫
        (podReindexingDerivedHom l E X s).map
          (Prod.mkHom (((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).commShiftIso a).inv.app M).op
            (𝟙 ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj N))) ≫
        (CategoryTheory.RingedHomUniverses.sourceShift.{u + 1, u, u, u + 2}
          (ProEt.topology X) (podReindexingRing l E X s)
          ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj M) a).inv.app
            ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj N) =
      (podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).map
        ((CategoryTheory.RingedHomUniverses.sourceShift.{u + 1, u, u, u + 2}
          (ProEt.topology Y) (podReindexingRing l E Y s) M a).inv.app N) ≫
        ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).commShiftIso (-a)).hom.app
          ((podReindexingDerivedHom l E Y s).obj (op M, N)) ≫
        (c.derived.hom.app (op M, N))⟦-a⟧'

source.place: Step 4, signed source shift of the representative internal Hom. Detailed normalization uses Stacks sites-cohomology.tex Tags 0A8X and 08JA, and the recorded LeftNormalization.

proof.text: The standard localization has the same objects as the complex category. Use Localization.Construction.objEquiv to write the source literally as QP, without needing a new source-naturality assertion about sourceShift.
Resolve the arbitrary target N by a K-injective complex I and choose the resulting isomorphism e : N ≅ QI. The ringed-site Grothendieck abelian result supplies the required resolution infrastructure.

For the now fixed source QP, form the two routes as natural transformations in the target. Their factors are the fixed-source specialization of c.derived, the Hom map of inverse F shift(a), the sourceShift inverse, and F shift(-a), with appropriate whiskerings. Naturality of c.derived in its target follows directly from its bifunctor naturality.

The representative premise gives equality of the two components at QI. Apply naturality of both transformations to e.hom. Their far-target components are isomorphisms, so cancellation gives equality at N. Expanding the whiskered components gives the required square.

proof_origin.note: Explicit specialization and factorization of the representative signed-source argument in the assigned node; the unit route is unchanged.
